definitions.explanation: The name and address written on mail or packages indicating where they should be delivered.

examples.japanese: {宛名|あてな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
{宛名|あてな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{間違|まちが}っていた→間違う：03036_machigau⟧。
⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宛名|あてな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write the address on an envelope.

notes:
USAGE: Specifically refers to the name/address of the recipient on mail, packages, or documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{宛名|あてな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write the address)
・{宛名|あてな}⟦{書|が}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (addressing mail)
・{宛名|あてな}⟦{ラベル|らべる}→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧ (address label)

ON JAPANESE ENVELOPES:
・{宛名|あてな} goes on the front center
・⟦{差出人|さしだしにん}→差出人：06316_sashidashinin⟧ (sender) goes on the back flap

RELATED:
・⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ - address (location)
・⟦{送り先|おくりさき}→送り先：23506_okurisaki⟧ - destination address
